Hi Claire — thanks for the profile. Quick follow-ups so we can finish the vendor master record and issue an initial PO: 

1) Confirm the exact legal entity you want on the vendor record (Peregrine Systems, Inc. vs any DBA).
2) Please provide FEIN (or W-9) for US tax classification and 1099/withholding checks.
3) Preferred remittance method: ACH or wire? If ACH, please confirm ACH details via your secure portal link and let us know the account name on file.
4) Primary PO contact and email for order acknowledgment (we prefer a single inbox for PO processing).
5) Any special invoicing instructions (PO number format, required fields, tax-exempt certificates, or third-party remit).

If you can send the FEIN/W-9 and point us at the secure bank details URL we can proceed. Our target is to have the vendor record created and a draft PO out within 48 hours of receiving the FEIN and remit instructions.

Marissa — tagging you for vendor master creation once Claire confirms entity + FEIN. Markus — heads-up in case you want to review payment terms if they ask for NET45 or different SLA.
